headline: Stock Market Today: Sensex Up 470 Points, Nifty Rises; Rupee Strengthens as Crude Oil Gets Cheaper - dainiktribuneonline.com
summary: Early trading saw the Sensex up 470 points and the Nifty gaining 150 points. Falling crude prices and foreign investor buying supported the market, while the rupee strengthened 31 paise to 95.12 per dollar.
why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indexes of Indian equities, and the rupee's level against the dollar affects foreign investors' returns.
why_moved: Lower crude oil prices, which help India as a large oil importer, and buying by foreign investors lifted the Sensex and Nifty and strengthened the rupee.
